title: Easy-to-Hard Oversight: Can Judges Calibrated on Easy Items Oversee Hard Ones?

original_idea.body:
# Easy-to-Hard Oversight: Can Judges Calibrated on Easy Items Oversee Hard Ones?

**Problem:** If a weak judge's trust calibration is set using easy items, does that calibration transfer to hard items it cannot directly verify?

**Direction:** On a difficulty-graded reasoning set, measure the judge's accuracy and confidence on easy items, derive a confidence-to-accept threshold, apply it to hard items and measure whether it stays well-calibrated. Test on multiple open judges.

**Why it matters:** Calibration transfer would give overseers a principled way to know when to trust hard outputs.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2403.09472; arXiv:2511.21692.
